name: profilesync
description: Shared website, Android WebView app, REST API and Supabase database with authentication and a synchronized user profile.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @profilesync/shared && npm run dev -w @profilesync/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @profilesync/shared && npm run dev -w @profilesync/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @profilesync/api && npm run build -w @profilesync/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @profilesync/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
